findings.what: A faint thin horizontal mark is visible right at the seam between the tab row and the zoom bubble's top edge (~y170-176, above 'Simple Mega'), not present in the un-annotated base capture at that spot. Much subtler than round 1's detached grey block — the crop no longer slices into the tab row's text — but it's a residual seam artifact.
findings.why: Worth a closer look next time this image is touched, but too subtle to read as a glitch to a reader and not worth spending the article's remaining fix budget on.
findings.fix: If revisited: nudge the zoom's y up by ~5-10px or add a couple px more top margin so the display box's top edge clears the seam with visible whitespace instead of sitting right against it.
